Frederick messaged me yesterday asking for the live-ops and push calendar for the Zombie Match 3D beta, the four buy weeks that start Monday the 6th. Can you take it on for me? What he wants in it is in his message, and his working rules for building it are in the brief he shared with me. It goes in my live-ops calendar sheet.

sources.quote: Julia, I need the live-ops and push calendar for the beta buy we start Mon Oct 6 through Sun Nov 2.
